description: This PHP source file is responsible for rendering the network setup and status page for a router or gateway device. It includes various network parameters such as WAN IP addresses, DHCP lease times, cable modem info, downstream and upstream channel details, and other device status information. The file outputs HTML with embedded PHP to dynamically fetch and display device configuration and status data.
